issues.title: Outside-canvas mouse release can leave stale Preview gesture state

prechangeEvidence.stalePan: After a held pan moved to (+40,+20), a buttons-zero mousemove changed translation by another 50 px to (+80,+50).
prechangeEvidence.staleDrag: After a held node move, a buttons-zero mousemove changed node position by 72.11102550927978 px.

issues.rootCause: Viz.onMove applied active drag/pan state without checking MouseEvent.buttons, while canvas-local mouseup and mouseleave were the only release termination paths.

postchangeContract.mousemove: A mousemove with buttons===0 clears stale drag/pan before applying node or transform changes; touch movement is not classified by this guard.
postchangeContract.fallbacks: Canvas mouseup, canvas mouseleave, window mouseup, window blur, touchend, and touchcancel terminate transient interaction state.
postchangeContract.preservation: S5-N01 compatible rerender carry-forward, selection behavior, world transform, node positions, graph/layout/view state, and Force/render/LOD architecture remain intact.
